prompt: A blue-robed tidecaller mage in deep sapphire and teal robes stands facing the viewer, arms spread wide, conjuring three distinct streams of water magic at once. From his left hand a curling wave of dark cerulean water rises like a barrier, swallowing an incoming fireball. From his right hand a frothing whitecap surge sweeps a small frog-creature backward out of the scene. Above his head floats a glowing scrying orb of pale aquamarine water showing faint visions. The background is a moonlit shoreline at night, dark stormy sea behind him, the only light is the cool blue glow of his three spells.

The background is a dark stormy coastline at dusk under a bruised purple sky, the only bright light is the pale aquamarine glow shining through the translucent wave.
